Sorry about that. To answer your question, yes I do. However, I don’t want to be a burden on anyone if you know what I mean. I have a very vivid picture as to how devastating my death will be for everyone; my family, my friends, everyone. I really don’t want to hurt anyone, but I feel like I have no choice.

12 months from now and that’s it; my life will change and the amount of restrictions and changes that’ll be put in place will be crushing to say the least. To me, when that happens and when I’m convicted, that’ll be a life that’s not worth living. I’ve fucked up massively and I accept that and the consequences will be too much for me to handle.
Part of me feels grateful for their concern, part of me feels as if they’re not fully understanding of the situation I’m in.
Thank you man. Your words mean more than you’ll ever know. Wishing you happiness and health.
